topic: Refreshable deep-archival routine for repo history (git + Linear joined corpus) with hyper-sphere RSI curve fitting and bounded recursive self improvement

subtopics.scope: The five sub-corpora the archive is built from: four git sub-corpora via GitHub REST (pulls, issues, commits, releases) with their field sets, plus the Linear GraphQL sub-corpus (team key OMN, not the display name). Covers the truncated-list-body caveat and pull_request-key filtering.
seed_queries: GitHub REST API list pull requests issues commits releases pagination per_page 100
Linear GraphQL API issues filter team key first orderBy updatedAt example

subtopics.scope: The three join keys: OMN regex on PR body, merge_commit_sha on the PR to commit SHA, and the 40-hex SHA regex on bodies. Covers why title joins and 7-char SHAs fail and why the full PR body must be fetched individually.
seed_queries: GitHub pull request merge_commit_sha squash merge commit semantics
GitHub REST API pull request body truncated list endpoint full body fetch

subtopics.scope: The 9-D binary primitive basis (p0 has_purpose through p8 has_temporal_anchor), its detection regexes, the near-constant filter that drops primitives above 90 percent or below 10 percent coverage, and the cycle-0 vs cycle-1 coverage measurements.

The Stage 1 lift: 9-D binary coverage to PCA top-2 right singular vectors to stereographic projection from the south pole onto S2, with Mobius reparameterization at identity init and the L-BFGS-B refine gate at N>=30 with cross-ratio preservation.
seed_queries: stereographic projection sphere to plane from south pole formula
Mobius transformation cross ratio invariant preservation

subtopics.scope: Stage 2 and the granularity rule: equal-area S2 partition, cKDTree with chordal radius about 0.095 to find isolated items, the sparse-cell list as the cycle priority queue, and the N<20 state-progression snapshot decomposition.
seed_queries: equal area partition of sphere into equal area cells points
scipy spatial cKDTree nearest neighbor chordal distance

subtopics.scope: The bounded recursive-self-improvement loop applied to the archive itself: cycle cap 3 with user override, the four edit types, the fixpoint rule (no new gaps, old gaps closed, no new anti-patterns), and the single-action-curve-rsi atom for Mode D.

Modes A through D (cold-start, incremental refresh, deep-research cycle, target-file RSI), the incremental refresh with --since and 7-day cache TTL warning, the deep-research hook dispatching 3 parallel streams, and the local plus pushed output artifacts.

The fit-quality gates (unit norm 1.0, PC1+PC2 >= 0.40, c.sum range 0 to 9, finite sparse cells), the red flags that trigger re-derivation or freezing, scale considerations up to 100k items, and the GitHub 5000 per hour and Linear 1500 per hour rate-limit guards.
seed_queries: PCA explained variance ratio first two components cumulative threshold
GitHub API rate limit 5000 requests per hour authenticated
